t: What does “guten tag” mean? - Quora
s: Answer (1 of 3): Both names in Polish and German mean "Good day". Guttentag is an archaic variant of standard German Guten Tag, while Dobrodzień is an archaic variant of standard Polish Dzień Dobry. Guten Tag is the German “hello” that's best-known to English speakers.
